note: Both sets capture the main claims accurately: negative damping from the generator-torque controller in Region 3, the derivative/proportional/integral term effects under positive gains, the second-order response, and the Ref. [10] design recommendations (ωφn = 0.6 rad/s, ζφ = 0.6–0.7, neglecting derivative gain and ignoring negative damping). Set B, however, repeats the rotor-speed-error second-order claim verbatim (claims 3 and 10) and also duplicates the negative-damping claim (1 and 8), adding redundancy without new information. Set A has only one near-duplicate pair (claims 1 and 10, the latter adding the constant-power condition), so it is marginally cleaner and more economical while keeping the same substantive content.
